correctness.rationale: The fixed graph Q4 has 16 vertices and 32 edges. A maximal matching is precisely a matching with independent unmatched vertices; the bipartition argument excludes sizes at most four. Independent vertex-first generation exhausts maximal matchings and returns exact counts size 6:192, size 7:1536, size 8:272; independent edge-subset enumeration tests all 201376 size-five and 906192 size-six edge subsets. Enumerating all 18336 pairs of 192 optima gives no one-exchanges, exactly 528 two-exchanges, degree counts 96 at degree five and 96 at six. All-source BFS yields 192 connected vertices and eccentricities 96 at five and 96 at six. Explicit 384 hypercube automorphisms yield two 96-state orbits, edge pair counts 48,96,384. These are exhaustive calculations on the entire finite state space, not sample-based extrapolation.
